source.value: Suppose that $|\,\mathbf{a}\,|=8,|\,\mathbf{b}\,|=4$ and that the angle between the vectors is $\theta = \dfrac{5\pi}{6}.$ Find the vector projection of $\mathbf{a}$ onto $\mathbf{b}$ in terms of the vector $\mathbf{b}.$

decisions.question: e-14617

source.question: e-14617
source.value:
First, we find the scalar projection as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{b}\,a & =|\,a\,|\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  \\  & =8\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{5\pi }{6}) \\  & =8\cdot (-\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}) \\  & =-4\sqrt{3}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we find the unit vector that is parallel to $\mathbf{b}\mathbin{:}$

$$
\mathbf{u} = \dfrac{\mathbf{b}}{|\,\mathbf{b}\,|} = \dfrac{\mathbf{b}}{4} = \dfrac{1}{4} \mathbf{b}
$$

Finally, we compute the vector projection as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{b}\,a & ={\text{comp}}_{b}\,a\cdot u \\  & =-4\sqrt{3}\cdot \frac{1}{4}b \\  & =-\sqrt{3}b\end{aligned}
$$

decisions.question: e-14618

source.question: e-14618
source.value:
Using the formula for the vector projection, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{b}\,a & =\frac{a\cdot b}{b\cdot b}b \\  & =\frac{{a}_{x}{b}_{x}+{a}_{y}{b}_{y}+{a}_{z}{b}_{z}}{{b}_{x}^{2}+{b}_{y}^{2}+{b}_{z}^{2}}b \\  & =\frac{1\cdot 5+(-3)\cdot (-4)+5\cdot 0}{{5}^{2}+(-4)^{2}+{0}^{2}}b \\  & =\frac{17}{41}⟨5,-4,0⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{85}{41},-\frac{68}{41},0⟩.\end{aligned}
$$
